integrity: All claimed equalities proved by determinant, Schur complement, and strict Jensen concavity; exact rational finite verification is supplementary and non-exhaustive. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact sequential two-pivot RPCholesky on a 3-by-3 Hermitian positive-definite matrix with spectrum {L,1,1}, L>1. No result on generic matrix sizes, other spectra, floating-point computation, or alternate sampling. Originality is best-knowledge, not independently certified.
title: Sharp orientation sensitivity of two-step randomly pivoted Cholesky on a three-dimensional rank-one spike
